tagline.zh-CN: 用一页纸浓缩今日日程、未读重要邮件与三项关键待办。
tagline.en: Distills today's schedule, important unread mail, and top three priorities onto one crisp page.

description.zh-CN: 面向个人与小团队的每日信息压缩助手：优先汇总已连接日历和邮箱中的关键信号，自动过滤通知噪音，并在无外部连接时也能根据用户口述生成结构化行动摘要。
description.en: A lightweight daily briefing assistant for individuals and small teams. Highlights high-signal calendar events and unread emails when connected, filters out automated noise, and falls back gracefully to manual notes.
